tips.text: Australia's Smartraveller says do not travel to Cabo Delgado province, the Erati and Memba districts of Nampula province, or the Marrupa and Mecula districts of Niassa province, because of terrorism, violent crime and kidnapping.
Carry your passport at all times. The UK government says police patrols and checkpoints are common and will not accept copies or photos of it.

If you need a border visa, Canada's travel advice says the fee can be paid by card or in accepted currencies; no official source publishes the amount, so carry enough US dollars in case the card terminal is down.

The UK government says cyclones and floods are common in the rainy season from November to April, often causing landslides, road closures and disruption to transport. Check forecasts if travelling then.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Mozambique?
faq.answer: Many tourists no longer need a visa. SADC citizens enter free, and under a 2023 decree citizens of about 30 major tourism-source countries — including the US, Portugal and most of Western Europe — enter visa-free for up to 30 days. British and Canadian citizens must first obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) online. Everyone else can get a simplified tourist visa at the border or apply online at evisa.gov.mz.

faq.question: What is the border fee for visa-free visitors?
faq.answer: Visa-exempt tourists under the 2023 scheme pay a MZN 650 processing fee (about USD 10). Decree 10/2023 sets it as payable when pre-registering at evisa.gov.mz at least 48 hours before boarding, so register and pay online before you fly. Mozambique's High Commission in London describes it as paid on arrival, so carry some cash too — meticais, dollars or rand are normally accepted.

faq.question: Can I get a Mozambique visa on arrival?
faq.answer: Sometimes. Mozambique's border visa allows two entries and 30 days, cannot be extended, and, according to Canada's travel advice, can be paid by card or in accepted currencies (no official source publishes the amount), but the migration service issues it mainly to nationals of countries where Mozambique has no embassy or consulate, or on reciprocity. Applying in advance through evisa.gov.mz is the safer route, especially if you arrive at a small crossing.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Mozambique?
faq.answer: Yes — tourist stays can normally be extended once, for up to 30 further days, at migration service (migração) offices in provincial capitals, though the border visa issued on arrival cannot be extended. Apply before your current permission expires; overstays are fined per day.

faq.question: Is Mozambique safe for tourists?
faq.answer: Check current advisories before you go. Australia's Smartraveller advises a high degree of caution in Mozambique overall and says do not travel to Cabo Delgado province and parts of Nampula and Niassa provinces, nor on stretches of the EN1 and EN6 roads. The UK government says you must carry your passport at all times.
